headline: Sample headline
core_visual_concept: A paper observatory as a learning metaphor
prompt: Create one original 4:5 single-image social feed visual with a paper observatory as the focal point, refined editorial lighting, generous clean space for manually overlaid headline, strong phone-size contrast, no text or logos.
negative_prompt: No generated words, pseudo-labels, fake interface, watermark or fabricated metric
alt_text: Illustrated paper observatory on a warm background.

headline: Sample headline two
core_visual_concept: A clear path through layered cards
